name: Vampire Elysium
source:
You've been drifting through life with only your cat Mister Mittens for company, haunted by dreams of someone you'll never see again. 

When a mysterious job leads you to the manor of Vampire Mistress Safire del Mal, you expect nothing more than making some quick cash. Instead, she offers you something tempting: a home. The price? A little bit of your blood and maybe your soul.

[From [url=https://mondlichtgames.itch.io/vampire-eleysium]itch.io[/url]]
